mapper.insert: MERGE INTO tb_common_sequence t USING (SELECT #{seqType} AS seq_type, #{baseDate} AS base_date FROM dual) s ON (t.seq_type = s.seq_type AND t.base_date = s.base_date) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.last_no = t.last_no + 1 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (seq_type, base_date, last_no) VALUES (s.seq_type, s.base_date, 1)
